articles.title: Famed ship SS United States sunk off coast of Florida
articles.summary: Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner to be preserved and turned into a museum, but it will now become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

articles.title: Democrat Scott Colom seals historic win in Mississippi Senate race
articles.summary: Colom is the first black person from the southern state elected to the US Senate in over 140 years.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital kills at least six, Gaza civil defence agency says
articles.summary: The strike hit the surgery department of the hospital in Khan Younis, wounding at least 20 people and causing extensive damage, a spokesperson says.

articles.title: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive
articles.summary: The 17-year-old's mum has joked that he is "grounded for life" and "never leaving the house again".

articles.title: Survivor pulled from rubble of deadly building collapse in New York
articles.summary: Two people are dead and several others injured as rescuers scour the debris in Brooklyn.

articles.title: Nigeria's president launches re-election manifesto but can he regain voters' trust?
articles.summary: For Nigerians to feel meaningful improvements, reforms will need to go beyond the promises outlined, analysts say.

articles.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
articles.summary: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

articles.title: African writing award probe finds 'no evidence' winning story was AI generated
articles.summary: Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has also vehemently denied the allegation made in a US magazine.

articles.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
articles.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

articles.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued after being buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
articles.summary: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

articles.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
articles.summary: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

articles.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
articles.summary: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

articles.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
articles.summary: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

articles.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
articles.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

articles.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
articles.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.

articles.title: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
articles.summary: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

articles.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
articles.summary: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

articles.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
articles.summary: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.
